title: Stalks of the pushforward along a finite morphism and vanishing of its higher direct images
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The proposition computes the stalks of the pushforward along a finite morphism, as a product over the finitely many points of the fibre for sheaves of sets and as a direct sum for abelian sheaves, and deduces the vanishing of the higher direct images (statement lines 8244-8264). The proof computes the stalk in both settings (proof lines 8266-8284) and then derives the vanishing in positive degrees from the same description of the stalks (proof lines 8284-8289). The non-formal content is the use of finiteness of the fibre and the identification of the product with the direct sum in the abelian case. The claim is H2: two computations and one vanishing, all written out.
